destination.name: Gold Coast
destination.tagline: Surf beaches, theme parks and a glitzy skyline on a warm subtropical coast
destination.description: The Gold Coast is a long strip of ocean beaches in Queensland's south-east corner, with more than 50 km of sand, almost all of it patrolled. Surfers Paradise is the high-rise hub of tourist activity, while Burleigh Heads and Currumbin have a quieter, local feel. Theme parks and wildlife sanctuaries fill out a visit, and rainforest-covered hills sit just inland.
whyVisit: Surf and swim the patrolled beaches

goodToKnow.title: Swim between the flags
goodToKnow.detail: Almost all beaches from the Seaway to Coolangatta are patrolled. Swim between the red and yellow flags and escape a rip by swimming parallel to shore.

goodToKnow.title: Tram and train links
goodToKnow.detail: A light-rail line runs along the coast through Surfers Paradise, and a train links the Gold Coast with Brisbane.

goodToKnow.title: Buy park tickets ahead
goodToKnow.detail: Discounted and combo tickets for the theme parks are sold before you travel, so buy ahead.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the drier months, with mild days for beaches and theme parks. Summer brings storms.
